label: Time-series line chart
description: A minimal NYT-style time-series line chart with 1-3 series over a shared X axis. Faint horizontal gridlines, small muted axis labels, thick 5-6px lines that draw on with a stroke reveal, and a dot that fades in at each vertex. A legend appears only when there is more than one series. Each series is a comma-separated list of 3-8 numeric points; the builder maps them to the plot, computes real path lengths, and animates the draw. The chart IS the scene; text stays minimal so narration carries the words.
validation: each series values is a comma-separated list of 3-8 numbers
stroke-dasharray driven by a real px path length computed in the builder
